media.alt: Justin Jefferson taking a selfie with the cast of Receiver at the Netflix premiere
media.caption: One of five pass-catchers profiled in “Receiver” — eight episodes from NFL Films and Omaha Productions following his 2023 season, premiered July 10, 2024.

media.alt: Justin Jefferson holding a basketball on the orange ESPN Cover Story set
media.caption: Twice an ESPN Cover Story — the 2022 original on the Griddy era, then relaunching the franchise with Anthony Edwards in 2024, recreating the iconic Garnett–Moss magazine cover.

media.alt: Justin Jefferson beside his prosthetic-disguised alter ego on the key art for Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers
media.caption: Buried under movie-grade prosthetics for “Eli Manning Presents: The Undercovers” — going undercover to prank unsuspecting fans on Prime Video.

media.alt: Justin Jefferson and his mom Elaine in a vintage Fiat on their GetYourGuide tour of Rome
media.caption: A mother-son Roman holiday with GetYourGuide — a private Vatican tour and vintage-Fiat laps with mom Elaine, picked up by Essence and Condé Nast Traveler.

media.alt: Justin Jefferson in a Vikings jersey in front of Christ the Redeemer on the NFL Going Global title card
media.caption: Fronting the NFL's “Going Global” series in Brazil — an all-access ambassador trip as the league pushes into South America.

media.alt: Justin Jefferson in an editorial studio shoot
media.caption: A recurring GQ Sports subject — “My First Million,” “10 Things,” and the London tunnel-fit breakdown that crowned him the NFL's best-dressed.

media.alt: Justin Jefferson hosting his Under Armour Flight School camp
media.caption: Fronted Under Armour's revived “Protect This House” film, shot in St. Rose, and the Flight School community films that followed.

media.alt: Justin Jefferson at an event appearance
media.caption: “A Football Life: Origins” (2024) — NFL Films on the climb from two-star recruit to the most productive young receiver in league history.

media.alt: Black-and-white portrait of Justin Jefferson in shades
media.caption: A recurring NFL Films Mic'd Up favorite — wired for Monday Night Football and the sideline moments that keep going viral.
